# Agent Cookbook

> A curated, community-driven repository of templates, plugins, and ecosystem maps for AI agent creation and vibecoding.

This repository provides standardized context files (like AGENTS.md), ecosystem directories, and tool registries for developers building multi-agent systems and using AI-native IDEs.

## Core Templates

- [AGENTS.md Starter Template](https://github.com/yourusername/agent-cookbook/blob/main/templates/AGENTS.md): The standard configuration file to drop into a repository to instruct AI coding assistants on project-specific rules, stack, and boundaries.
- [Issue Template for Tool Submissions](https://github.com/yourusername/agent-cookbook/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/submit_tool.md): The required YAML format for submitting a new MCP server or agent framework to the cookbook.

## Ecosystem Directories

- [Vibe Coding IDEs](https://github.com/yourusername/agent-cookbook/blob/main/README.md#vibe-coding-ides--app-builders): A directory of AI-native IDEs (Cursor, Windsurf) and prompt-to-app builders.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers](https://github.com/yourusername/agent-cookbook/blob/main/README.md#model-context-protocol-mcp-servers): A directory of official and community MCP servers for granting agents local filesystem, database, and browser access.
- [Core Agent Frameworks](https://github.com/yourusername/agent-cookbook/blob/main/README.md#core-agent-frameworks): A directory of stateful and code-first orchestrators like LangGraph and CrewAI.

## Optional

- [llms.txt Official Specification](https://llmstxt.org/): The official spec for formatting this file.
